messages.text: What happed to Labs. I signed up about a week ago and now cant find it.
Used the store-orders skill
Searched the catalog · Labs
Used the store-orders skill

Happy to sort that out, but I want to be sure which one you mean. Is it the Harlo Labs site (harlolabs.com), where the Harlo OS downloads and account live, or something you signed up for on our store?

I can see your Thor P2 order from October 3, which included the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA, so if the sign-up was tied to that, tell me and I'll chase it from there.
there was a tab on top of Helium Deploy called Labs. I created a user name and could chat with others

Thanks, that's clearer. I don't have anything on my side that tells me what happened to the Labs tab or the account you made there, and I won't guess at it.

I've passed it to the team so they can tell you exactly where it went and whether your username is still there. They pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to (email hidden), so you don't need to wait here.
Handed to the team · No information on my side about the Labs tab or its accounts; will not guess.
Anything else I can help with in the meantime?
Thank you, yes. how do I join your discord?

Here you go: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

That link takes you straight in, no username needed beyond your own Discord account. JD, who handles the hardware side, is in there as @nullhashrate (shown as JD, Admin role), and the community is very active, so it's the fastest place for Harlo OS, setup or pool questions on your Thor P2.
Great, thank you.

Any time. You'll hear on the Labs account by email tomorrow.

One thing I'm curious about while you're here: what were you using Labs for, mostly chatting with other miners, or were you after something specific in there?
For tips on specific miners from other users, showing off our rigs

That's good to know, and it's exactly what the Discord is for. People post rig photos and swap tuning tips there all day, so you'd land in the same crowd.

Was the tips side or the showing-off side the bigger pull for you? It helps me pass on what people actually want back.
I keep getting an error for the discord link you sent me.

Most often that's the browser not being signed in to Discord. Try opening the Discord app, click the plus on the left, Join a Server, and paste https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf there.

If it still fails, what does the error say, "Invite Invalid" or "Expired"? That tells me whether the link itself needs refreshing, and I'll get you a fresh one.
invalid invite

That's on us, not you. That invite is the only one I have, and I can't generate a new one myself.

I've asked the team for a fresh working invite. They pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and it'll come to (email hidden), along with the answer on your Labs account, so you don't need to sit here waiting.
Handed to the team · Cannot mint Discord invites; link discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf returns Invalid Invite.
Sorry for the runaround on that one.
thank you, thats all I have

Glad to help. Both items, the Labs account and a working Discord invite, come to your email tomorrow, and a copy of this whole conversation lands there too once we close here.

Enjoy the Thor P2 in the meantime.
Im loving it

That's good to hear. It's a quiet little unit for 10 TH/s, and it earns its spot on a desk.

Take care, and you'll have both answers in your inbox tomorrow.
